news.text: #SPALLETTI IT IS STILL DARK#Juve only 2-2 against #Rennes (but the 3-2 was onside)"This time too, I won't sleep". The future is in Lecce. #Carnevali: "At our club, the dugout burns hot..."[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]

ALL HEART #JUVEVAR heartbreak at the endReaction after the flop against #Lazio: 2-2 in the Europa League. #Rennes pulled back: #Woltemade saves the day. #Çelik breaks the deadlock, #AlTaamari reponds. Post by #McKennie. Dia overtakes from the penalty spot. The German scores the equalizer from the spot. #Lucumí scores in the 89th minute, but he is offside. #Spalletti seventh: 7 points in 3 matchdays. [Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#WOLTE AND THAT'S IT#Juve-#Rennes 2-2Another disappointment, more boos and more trouble for #Spalletti: only the German shows the right spirit.#Woltemade sets up #Çelik for the 1-0, wins the penalty for the 2-2, tries every possible way and plays for his teammates. But the confusion and the mistakes of the bianconeri are baffling, punished by #AlTaamari and #Dia from the penalty spot. A 3-2 goal by #Lucumí was disallowed for a debatable offside. #Carnevali: "The dugout burns hot, but you can't change every single time. #Spalletti knows what he must do". The coach attacks the referee and polemicizes over the sacking rumors: "I will continue to lose sleep at night..."[Front Page TuttoSport]

3/3 - Nick #Woltemade is only the third player to have scored in each of his first three appearances with #Juventus in major European competitions, after Darko #Kovacevic in 1999 and Roberto #Baggio in 1990. Giant.#JuventusRennes #UEL[Opta Paolo]
#Juventus-#Rennes, #Celik was substituted because he felt a discomfort in his thigh.[IlBianconero]
